ios.desc:
FuseCells is a fresh grid logic puzzle built around one simple rule: every number tells you how many neighboring cells must share the same symbol.
No ads. No guessing. Just pure logic.
Inspired by the deduction of Sudoku, the neighbor logic of Minesweeper, and the pattern reasoning of Nonogram, FuseCells creates an original and satisfying cosmic puzzle experience. 

HOW TO PLAY
Fill every cell with a cosmic symbol: Planet, Star, or Moon.
Each number clue shows how many neighboring cells must contain the same symbol. Some puzzles use 4-way neighbors, while others include all 8 surrounding directions.

Color-coded feedback keeps everything clear:
• Green means correct
• Yellow means still possible
• Red means impossible

Follow the clues, eliminate impossible choices, and reveal the solution using logic alone.

YOUR COSMIC JOURNEY
Travel through one continuous roadmap filled with carefully curated puzzles.

• 3×3, 4×4, and 5×5 grids
• 4-way and 8-way logic
• Gradually evolving difficulty
• Quick levels between harder challenges
• Milestone summaries every 10 levels
• Crystal ratings for efficient solutions
• Personal best times and progress tracking

The journey introduces new ideas naturally while keeping the rules simple and easy to understand.

DAILY CHALLENGES
Return every day for a new shared puzzle.

• Build your Daily Challenge streak
• Compare your result with other players
• Climb the global rankings
• Unlock badges and achievements
• Improve your time and logical thinking

WHY PLAYERS LOVE FUSECELLS
• Original grid-based deduction gameplay
• Every puzzle is validated and logically solvable
• No random guessing
• No advertisements
• Clean, minimalist cosmic design
• Relaxing gameplay with satisfying progression
• Perfect for quick breaks or longer sessions
• Main journey can be played offline

Start your journey, follow the clues, and discover how far pure logic can take you.
The grid is waiting.

quotes.text:
Hi everyone,
I built FuseCells, a minimalistic logic puzzle game where every level is handcrafted (no procedural generation). It started as a personal challenge to design a clean rule-set and scale it to thousands of puzzles without losing difficulty balance.

What’s unique:
 • 2,500 handcrafted levels across multiple grid sizes
 • Deterministic logic — no guessing required
 • A rule system inspired by constraint-solving and path-finding concepts
 • Daily challenges and global progress tracking
 • Fully built as a solo dev project

Technical notes for those curious:
 • Level generation tools I wrote validate solvability using a custom constraint solver
 • Difficulty is estimated via step-count of the solver
 • The game is optimized to run smoothly on low-end devices
 • Designed first for iOS, now fully adapted for iPad as well

I’d love feedback from puzzle lovers, game designers, and anyone interested in handcrafted logic design.
Here’s the App Store link: [inserați linkul]

Thanks for reading — happy to answer any technical questions!
